data.rationale: The Resplendent Quetzal is one of the most strikingly colorful birds in the world, with iridescent plumage spanning greens, reds, blues, and golds — perfectly mirroring Birds of Paradise's ability to produce mana of any color. Revered as sacred by ancient Mesoamerican civilizations, it carries a mythic quality befitting the card's iconic status. Its lush tropical forest habitat and breathtaking beauty make it a natural embodiment of green mana and prismatic versatility.
